lines.text: David lives in a cedar house while the ark is under a tent, and Nathan says go ahead.
That night God tells Nathan David will not build Him a house, for He has lived in tents.
God has been with David wherever he went, cut off his enemies, and will make him a great city.
God promises David's son will build Him a house and never lose His loving devotion.
David sits before the LORD, asks who he is, and says God acted according to Nathan's heart.
